metric_definitions.best_update_count: max(0, len(winner history) - 1); history records warm start and each accepted best improvement
metric_definitions.unique_solution_count: distinct solution_signature_hash values in winner history plus final best solution
metric_definitions.zero_violations: check_solution returned no hard or soft violations for the reported solution
metric_definitions.first_gate_pass: at least one documented 100c exception improves and no 150/200c sanity row regresses by more than 0.5 percent
